sql_templates.description: Fetches VCP candidates with strong fundamentals.
sql_templates.name: get_vcp_candidates_with_fundamentals
sql_templates.template:
SELECT eod.symbol, eod.close, eod.high, eod.volume, snap.stage, snap.fundamental_score, vcp.vcp_score
FROM market.equity_eod AS eod
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots AS snap ON eod.symbol = snap.symbol
JOIN scores.stage2_vcp_picks AS vcp ON eod.symbol = vcp.symbol
WHERE eod.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)
AND snap.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
AND vcp.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks)
AND snap.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
AND snap.stage = 'STAGE_2'
ORDER BY vcp.vcp_score DESC
LIMIT 50;

synthesis_guidance: ['Prioritize exceptions and gaps in the data first.', 'Ensure results align with Indian market context.']
